# Michelle Creamer — Realtor®, ARC Realty

> Real estate agent for Liberty Park and Vestavia Hills, Alabama, in the greater
> Birmingham market. Realtor® and Associate Broker with ARC Realty. Alabama real
> estate license #70777. Licensed in Alabama since 2002.
> Canonical site: https://michellesellslibertypark.com/

## Who she is

Michelle Creamer is a Realtor® and Associate Broker with ARC Realty, working out of
the ARC office in Vestavia Hills, Alabama. Her focus is Liberty Park — a
master-planned community in Vestavia Hills, about 20 minutes from downtown
Birmingham — along with the wider Vestavia Hills and Birmingham metro market. She has
lived in Liberty Park for more than 20 years with her husband and two children, and
has been licensed as a real estate agent in Alabama since 2002. She holds a B.S. from Jacksonville
State University and spent 20 years in development with a Birmingham-based non-profit,
helping purchase and adapt homes for adults with physical and mental disabilities.

## What she does

- Represents buyers purchasing homes in Liberty Park, Vestavia Hills and greater Birmingham
- Represents sellers listing homes in the same market
- Prepares home valuations and pricing guidance for sellers; the site offers the estimate free and with no obligation
- Advises families relocating into the Birmingham metro, backed by ARC's relocation department
- Represents buyers in Liberty Park new construction, including The Bray and Old Overton
- Handles luxury property, acreage and lots, and refers commercial needs to ARC commercial specialists

## Areas served

Liberty Park and Vestavia Hills first, then the greater Birmingham metropolitan area,
Alabama. Named Liberty Park neighborhoods: Old Overton, The Bray, and Vestlake.
Monthly market reports are offered for Liberty Park, Vestavia Hills, Mountain Brook,
Hoover, Homewood, greater Birmingham, Montgomery and the lake communities.

## Liberty Park in brief

- Master-planned community inside the city of Vestavia Hills, Alabama
- About 20 minutes from downtown Birmingham
- Zoned to Vestavia Hills City Schools, with two schools inside the community:
  Vestavia Hills Elementary Liberty Park and Liberty Park Middle
- Housing runs from townhomes and garden homes to custom builds and lake homes.
  Price points move with each phase — read the current ones on the Liberty Park page
  rather than quoting them from here
- Old Overton: gated estates around the Old Overton Club championship golf course
- The Bray: the community's town center — condos, townhomes, shops, restaurants,
  a hotel, apartments and the Great Lawn
- Vestlake: established family neighborhoods built around lakes, pools and swim clubs
